cases.name: Kelly Jeanne Coppola
cases.narrative: Assistant District Attorney Eric Aboulafia said at the arraignment that Coppola texted his teenage daughter to come out of the house shortly before midnight Wednesday. Coppola then shot through the lock on the front door, went upstairs and shot Pohlman and Kelly Coppola dead, Aboulafia said. “He put a premeditated plan into action,” the prosecutor said, while his daughter waited in the car.
